description: Higgsfield relights a picture photo-real: everything stays, only the light changes (like the Thumbnail studio's Make it real). Give a picture file path or a generated picture id, and the light in words. A new picture is made; the original stays. Spends the person's Higgsfield credits: the first call (without confirm) only returns the price and credits left; ask the person, then call again with the same arguments and confirm: true. Waits up to about 50 s; if it isn't done, call generate_picture with action status. The result goes to media, a shot's background, or nowhere. To light a shot in the app itself (free), use set_light.

confirm.description: true only after the person agreed to the price.

id.description: A generated_pictures id instead of a path.

light.description: The light, like 'warm low sun from the left, soft blue fill'.

path.description: Full path of a PNG, JPG or WebP on this computer. Or give id.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

name: relight
